policy.public_pages_only: Fetch only publicly accessible pages. Respect robots.txt and site terms. Nothing behind a sign-in, paywall or access control.
policy.git_holds: this manifest: URL, retrieval date, SHA-256 of the retained body, labelled spans as minimal excerpts, missingness, rights status
policy.private_body_directory: var/evidence/corpus/ (gitignored through /var/). Proposed here; Task 3 confirms the path in the runbook.
rights_status_values: permitted: <licence or terms, quoted and dated>
reference only: retain minimal excerpts and hash, not the body
policy.counts: Failure-only attempts (attempt_cases) do not count toward the 20/10/3 page minimums.
policy.holdout_split: Assign tuning or holdout by source/template family before any prompt or parser tuning, so near-duplicate pages never appear in both (plan section 9).

slot_template.label_review: not run - requires human domain reviewer
